review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, maintainer decision 2026-09-25, third to fifth passes 2026-09-26: runtime (GUI) translation debt written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: Announce every run that finishes or fails, by the ways switched on below, with its name, duration, outcome, a short QC summary and where its output is. Runs from the app and from the command line are both announced. A run you cancel is not. Default off.
records.source: Announce every run that finishes or fails, by the ways switched on below, with its name, duration, outcome, a short QC summary and where its output is. Runs from the app and from the command line are both announced. A run you cancel is not. Default off.
records.translation: Anunciar cada execução que termina ou falha, pelas formas ativadas abaixo, com nome, duração, resultado, um breve resumo de QC e o local da saída. Execuções pelo aplicativo e pela linha de comando são ambas anunciadas. Uma execução cancelada não é. Padrão desativado.

records.key: Delete the saved mail password, Slack webhook and ntfy topic and token from the keyring and from spaCR's own file, at once. Default kept.
records.source: Delete the saved mail password, Slack webhook and ntfy topic and token from the keyring and from spaCR's own file, at once. Default kept.
records.translation: Apaga de uma vez a senha de e-mail, o webhook do Slack e o tópico e o token ntfy salvos, do chaveiro e do próprio arquivo do spaCR. Padrão mantidos.

records.key: How the connection to the mail server is encrypted. None sends the password in the clear and is only for a server on your own network. Default STARTTLS.
records.source: How the connection to the mail server is encrypted. None sends the password in the clear and is only for a server on your own network. Default STARTTLS.
records.translation: Como a conexão com o servidor de e-mail é criptografada. None envia a senha sem criptografia e serve apenas para um servidor na própria rede. Padrão STARTTLS.

records.key: If you can read this, spaCR can tell you when a run finishes or fails.
records.source: If you can read this, spaCR can tell you when a run finishes or fails.
records.translation: Se esta mensagem está legível, o spaCR pode avisar quando uma execução termina ou falha.

records.key: No scratch found: the largest open area is {percent} of the field
records.source: No scratch found: the largest open area is {percent} of the field
records.translation: Nenhum risco encontrado: a maior área aberta é {percent} do campo

records.key: Only runs that took at least this long are announced, so a quick run you are watching does not send anything. 0 announces every run. Default 5 min.
records.source: Only runs that took at least this long are announced, so a quick run you are watching does not send anything. 0 announces every run. Default 5 min.
records.translation: Somente execuções que duraram pelo menos este tempo são anunciadas, para que uma execução rápida que está sendo acompanhada não envie nada. 0 anuncia todas as execuções. Padrão 5 min.

records.key: Post to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook. Default off.
records.source: Post to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook. Default off.
records.translation: Publicar em um canal do Slack por meio de um webhook de entrada. Padrão desativado.

records.key: Publish to an ntfy topic, which the ntfy phone app or web page shows as a push notification. Default off.
records.source: Publish to an ntfy topic, which the ntfy phone app or web page shows as a push notification. Default off.
records.translation: Publicar em um tópico ntfy, que o aplicativo ntfy no celular ou a página web mostra como notificação push. Padrão desativado.
Endpoint compatível com S3 (em branco para Amazon S3)

records.key: Send a test message now by every way switched on above, using what is typed here, and say which got through. Nothing is saved. Default not sent.
records.source: Send a test message now by every way switched on above, using what is typed here, and say which got through. Nothing is saved. Default not sent.
records.translation: Enviar agora uma mensagem de teste por cada forma ativada acima, usando o que foi digitado aqui, e informar quais chegaram. Nada é salvo. Padrão não enviado.

records.key: Send an email through the SMTP server below. Your institution's or mail provider's server works; many need an app password rather than your usual one. Default off.
records.source: Send an email through the SMTP server below. Your institution's or mail provider's server works; many need an app password rather than your usual one. Default off.
records.translation: Enviar um e-mail pelo servidor SMTP abaixo. O servidor da instituição ou do provedor de e-mail funciona; muitos exigem uma senha de aplicativo em vez da senha habitual. Padrão desativado.

records.key: Show a notification on this computer, from the system tray while the app is open, or through the desktop's own notifications for a command-line run. Default on.
records.source: Show a notification on this computer, from the system tray while the app is open, or through the desktop's own notifications for a command-line run. Default on.
records.translation: Mostrar uma notificação neste computador, pela bandeja do sistema enquanto o aplicativo está aberto, ou pelas notificações da área de trabalho em uma execução pela linha de comando. Padrão ativado.

records.key: Show the open wound Measure would start a wound-closure series from if this field were its first frame, using the Wound Closure settings of the run.
records.source: Show the open wound Measure would start a wound-closure series from if this field were its first frame, using the Wound Closure settings of the run.
records.translation: Mostra a ferida aberta a partir da qual o Measure iniciaria uma série de fechamento de ferida se este campo fosse seu primeiro quadro, com as configurações de fechamento de ferida da execução.

records.key: Switch on at least one way to be told first.
records.source: Switch on at least one way to be told first.
records.translation: Ative primeiro pelo menos uma forma de ser avisado.

records.key: The server's port: usually 587 with STARTTLS, 465 with SSL. Default 587.
records.source: The server's port: usually 587 with STARTTLS, 465 with SSL. Default 587.
records.translation: A porta do servidor: geralmente 587 com STARTTLS, 465 com SSL. Padrão 587.

records.key: Which runs are announced: every run that ends, or only the ones that fail. Default when a run finishes or fails.
records.source: Which runs are announced: every run that ends, or only the ones that fail. Default when a run finishes or fails.
records.translation: Quais execuções são anunciadas: toda execução que termina, ou apenas as que falham. Padrão quando uma execução termina ou falha.
Ferida {percent} aberta, largura média {mean} {unit}, mais estreita {narrowest} {unit}

records.key: spaCR can tell you when a long run finishes or fails: on this computer's desktop, by email, in Slack or through ntfy. Nothing is sent until you switch it on here. Passwords and addresses that work like passwords are kept in the system keyring.
records.source: spaCR can tell you when a long run finishes or fails: on this computer's desktop, by email, in Slack or through ntfy. Nothing is sent until you switch it on here. Passwords and addresses that work like passwords are kept in the system keyring.
records.translation: O spaCR pode avisar quando uma execução longa termina ou falha: na área de trabalho deste computador, por e-mail, no Slack ou pelo ntfy. Nada é enviado até que isso seja ativado aqui. Senhas e endereços que funcionam como senhas ficam no chaveiro do sistema.
